LinkedIn Cuts Daily Spark Shuffle Fetch Failures from 750 to 20 with Apache Celeborn
items.summary: LinkedIn deployed Apache Celeborn as a shared remote shuffle platform across most Spark and Flink workloads, reducing daily shuffle fetch failures from approximately 750 to 20. The deployment also low...
items.description: LinkedIn deployed Apache Celeborn as a shared remote shuffle platform across most Spark and Flink workloads, reducing daily shuffle fetch failures from approximately 750 to 20. The deployment also lowered compute costs by 10%, improved application runtimes by 14%, and reduced shuffle costs per task by nearly 90% through dedicated storage, replication, and data-plane optimizations. By Leela Kumili

items.summary: Data contracts are a way to describe the contents and guarantees of datasets. Simon Harrer and Arif Wider describe in detail what they are and how to use them. They apply practices from API design to ...
items.description: Data contracts are a way to describe the contents and guarantees of datasets. Simon Harrer and Arif Wider describe in detail what they are and how to use them. They apply practices from API design to data by treating them as data-providing services - such as data products - whose interfaces we want to define as clearly as possible.

Presentation: Behind Booking.com's AI Evolution: The Unpolished Story
items.summary: Jabez Eliezer Manuel discusses the 20-year evolution of Booking.com’s data management and ML platforms. He explains how they scaled MySQL topologies, sunset Hadoop for cloud architecture, and built hi...
items.description: Jabez Eliezer Manuel discusses the 20-year evolution of Booking.com’s data management and ML platforms. He explains how they scaled MySQL topologies, sunset Hadoop for cloud architecture, and built high-throughput model serving and feature stores operating at 400B predictions per day. He also shares insights on personalization, interleaved experimentation, and their new agentic AI foundation.

items.title: Vercel Releases UI SDK for Agents to Compose UI from Reusable Behaviors
items.summary: Vercel has released UI SDK in beta, an Apache 2.0 TypeScript library of more than 50 UI behaviors in @ui-sdk/core, with adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, so agents can compos...
items.description: Vercel has released UI SDK in beta, an Apache 2.0 TypeScript library of more than 50 UI behaviors in @ui-sdk/core, with adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, so agents can compose accessible components and operate them through a documented agent bridge. By Daniel Dominguez
